name: structured-json-logs
prompt: main.go logs with bare log.Println/log.Fatal, which makes production logs hard to query. Introduce a small structured logger: add func logLine(level, message string, fields map[string]any) in main.go that writes one JSON object per line to the standard logger with keys {"level", "msg", plus each field}. Convert the existing log.Println startup line to logLine("info", "listening", map[string]any{"addr": addr-less: just use the same message text as today: logLine("info", "listening on :8080", nil)}) — keep the existing message strings exactly, and log.Fatal stays as-is (process exit semantics). No external dependencies.
